# heraut notes

Print the release notes of a tag.

Print the release notes of a tag: the changelog's groups and commit lines for the range from the tag's
previous release (or --from) to the tag. Read-only. Shape the output with the notes: block of .heraut.yml,
or --template for one run; --format text converts the Markdown to plain text.

## Usage

```text
heraut notes <tag> [flags]
```

## Examples

```bash
heraut notes v1.2.0
heraut notes v1.2.0 --format text --output notes.txt
heraut notes v1.2.0 --from v1.0.0
```

## Flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--env <string>` |  | target environment (for per-env strategies) |
| `--format <string>` | `markdown` | output format: markdown or text |
| `--from <string>` |  | lower bound of the range (default: the tag's previous release) |
| `--offline` |  | skip remote PR/MR metadata enrichment (forces enrichment_policy: disabled); outside CI, commit links go too |
| `--output <string>` |  | write the notes to this file instead of stdout |
| `--overwrite` |  | replace the --output file if it already exists |
| `--template <string>` |  | template file for this run (replaces notes.template) |

## Global flags

| Flag | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--config <string>` |  | path to .heraut.yml (default: auto-discover) |
| `--verbose` |  | echo each command and emit diagnostic logs |
